title: מתנקשת סייבר סגולה
summary: הסטרימרית מציתת אנרגיה סגולה בידה והופכת למתנקשת סייבר משוריינת עם גלימה ועיניים זוהרות שקמה ומזנקת אל המצלמה.

phases.what: Streamer sits at desk, snaps fingers creating a purple spark
Purple lightning shoots from hand, dark metallic mask covers lower face, armored glove appears
Dark hood, full face mask with glowing purple eyes, and shoulder armor materialize
She stands up in full black/silver cyber armor and cape on a glowing purple floor grid
Turns to face camera, rooms turns into a high-tech purple command center, reaches hand forward
Dashes forward into the camera in a burst of purple lightning

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and snaps their fingers, sparking bright purple energy. Keep the person recognizable until the mask and hood cover the face. Purple lightning shoots from their hand as a black metallic mask covers their lower face and a dark hood, glowing purple eyes, and silver shoulder armor materialize. They stand up, fully transforming into a sleek cyber-assassin in black and silver tactical armor with a flowing dark cape, standing on a glowing purple floor grid as the room becomes a futuristic purple neon command center. They reach toward the camera with a glowing hand, then dash explosively into the lens in a flash of purple lightning. Cinematic purple neon lighting, vertical framing.
